platform: Windows x86_64, local ChatGPT subscription, gpt-6.1-sol, official standalone Codex CLI 0.167.0
protocol: Rotate native/current/reopen, current/reopen/native, reopen/native/current across five independent nine-file fixtures. Within each fixture reuse exactly the same bytes and list order. Two suffix questions select the third and eighth VALUE. Fresh editor settings for every case.

The baseline native entry launches codex exec and exec resume. The candidate comparison uses one native Codex app-server ephemeral read-only thread across three turns. Report them separately. All model trials run serially.

Editor samples require exact answers, nine ordered result receipts, unchanged fixture hashes, two tool-free follow-ups, same conversation and three terminal receipts. Reopen timings cover leaving, fresh access check and reopening existing issue conversation before sending. full_answer_ms measures from Send, excluding reopen_ms.

model_ms spans turn/start to completed output. input_text_bytes is the UTF-8 length of the text input to that RPC, excluding output schema and RPC framing. issue_binding_ms times live intake. receipt_flush_ms sums scoped durable flush calls including terminal flush until next intake, and may overlap displayed answer time. account_read_ms is the live Codex account read. These fields are not additive.
One baseline current-composer case predates Python timing instrumentation. Null denotes unavailable measurements. Each P95 is nearest-rank and equals the maximum at n=5.

Initial nine-file user prompt is specific to the tool surface: native shell vs Godot read_file. Follow-up messages and expected values match. Neither of the two follow-ups invokes tools. No statistics use the earlier one-sample reference.

The running Windows executable and UI package are identical across both editor measurements. The JS subscription bridge is loaded from each installation. Concurrent main changes between host bases and live provider latency limit attribution of differences in wall-clock time.

verification.native_recovery: Packaged host CLI child inherited a registered Windows Core environment and failed to start shell. Isolated standalone CLI with desktop IPC and registered-Core variables removed read the nine actual files and returned exact suffixes.
verification.retained_592_cancel_failure: Initial post-cancel strict answer failed on the previous main. Same binary rerun passed. Cause of initial mismatch is unknown.
verification.rechecks: All five fixtures passed each final entry. Earlier reopens (fixtures 2 and 3) and a composer check (fixture 3) stopped before sending. The original probe directly assigned current or checked button state before text entry. Repeat checks selected the actual issue row and set the draft before checking Send. The initial failures had no notice snapshot, so the specific causes remain unknown.
verification.observer_setup_failure: A Windows NODE_OPTIONS preload path lost its backslashes; context rejected the call before model execution. Corrected the observer path and reran. The first separate nine-file editor pilot produced 240 characters and failed exact match.
verification.paired_interpretation: In each of ten successful editor conversations per phase, the first follow-up rebuilt after tool-history cleanup and the second reused acknowledged history. Exactly one model turn per successful follow-up, zero observed duplicate sends. Baseline second follow-up input was 16328 bytes, candidate 689. Wall-clock medians did not improve; provider time, live intake and durable receipts remain measurable.
verification.build: Local cached builds refused a changed native input fingerprint while the private measurement folder was being written. Isolated uncached local build completed, and all 45 native cases passed on the tested binary.
verification.review_fixes: The first independent 6 Astra review requested invalidation after provider-side context compaction and fail-safe handling of deeply nested JSON. Final code covers both and clears acknowledgement before a new turn. Both normal editor entries passed again on the revised JS. The two post-review samples are separate from the five-fixture matrix.
verification.final_review: Two revisions addressed compaction, deep JSON fallback, and a compaction notification during an outstanding outcome-only update. The latter discards the terminal output and proposed actions; a later work-order submission reauthenticates. Final isolated gpt-6-astra review approved scoped code delivery. Business acceptance remains open.
verification.post_review_samples: Post-review rows 1-4 exercise the first compaction fix in current and reopened conversations. Rows 5-6 exercise the final candidate in the current composer; the final code also passed the targeted in-turn/idle compaction, failed turn and authorization regressions.
